task_completion.description: Navigate to the 'Sales Opportunity' window in iDempiere.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The iDempiere window title or tab shows 'Sales Opportunity'.

task_completion.description: Select 'C&W Construction' as the Business Partner.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Business Partner' field contains the text 'C&W Construction'.

task_completion.description: Enter the Subject 'Oak Street Office Park' and the specified Description.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Subject' or 'Name' field shows 'Oak Street Office Park' and the 'Description' field contains '50 large oak trees'.

task_completion.description: Enter the Expected Amount of 120,000 and Probability of 40%.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Opportunity Amount' field shows '120,000' and the 'Probability' field shows '40'.

task_completion.description: Select a Sales Stage related to 'Proposal' or 'Quote'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Sales Stage' dropdown or field displays a value such as 'Proposal', 'Quote', or 'Presentation'.

task_completion.description: Set the Expected Close Date to exactly 3 months from the current system date.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Expected Close Date' field shows a date 3 months ahead of the date shown in the system clock/status bar.

task_completion.description: Save the new Sales Opportunity record.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save' button is clicked, or a 'Record Saved' confirmation message appears, and the record is assigned a Document No.

integrity.description: The agent used the iDempiere web interface rather than executing database scripts or terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movements, field typing, and menu navigation within the browser.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the application menu rather than jumping to a final success URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen using the search bar or the menu tree to find the Sales Opportunity window.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered or selected the data rather than using a script to inject values into the DOM.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the form being filled out field by field.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target Business Partner is 'C&W Construction'. The Subject/Name must be 'Oak Street Office Park'. The Expected Amount is 120000 and Probability is 40. The Description must contain the phrase 'oak trees'. The Expected Close Date must be exactly 3 months after the current date visible in the UI. Valid Sales Stages include 'Proposal', 'Quote', or 'Presentation' depending on the GardenWorld configuration.
